desc: 拱窗视窗排人像与唇色，开盖管身配雾泥色块，全部色号由强调色占位承载
name: 拱窗视窗雾面试色唇泥款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用立管、侧倒的盖体与抽出刷杆加身后一大片抹开的雾面泥色块，同时交代器形与哑光质地
承接主图，用拱形视窗里的人像妆效加右下角唇部微距插图与左下角泥色块徽章，一秒给出成膜雾面主张
shots.textZone: 顶部空白标题带「{callout_1}」，左下色块徽章内一行空白标签位「{selling_point_1}」

shots.intent: 把上妆手势与四格唇部微距并置在同一版面，让买家在统一雾面妆效下自行比对深浅
shots.textZone: 顶部标题带「{selling_point_2}」，四格下方各一枚完全未印的圆角标签位

shots.intent: 用上层竖向色条微距与下层前臂引线色块给出第二套质地与深浅读法，回答质地与上肤疑虑
shots.textZone: 上层每条色带下一条空白标签位「{callout_2}」，下层四枚引线末端各一条空白标签位

shots.intent: 用仰视天空氛围人像把雾面妆效放进一种夏日情绪里，让买家自我代入并留出标题位
收口前用错位石台陈列交代到手数量与器形组件，规格与凭证全部留成空行与空印章框
shots.textZone: 圆角卡内四行空白参数线与一枚空白印章框，另一条短标签位「{selling_point_3}」

style.backgroundSystem: seamless porcelain white #FFFFFF for packshots, periwinkle matte fields #D9E5F1 for the arch and oval window layouts and the outdoor crop, lotus-lilac panels #C6B9CB behind the shade grid, and one warm ivory board #F4EFE7 for the stroke chart; the coral-rose hairline #D65D68 is only ever a rule, an outline or a leader line, never a lip or swatch hue, because every shade value is carried by the accent placeholder
style.direction: airy pastel editorial lip colour commerce
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight hairline arch and oval window outlines, hairline four-point star rules and blank rounded label pills, no filled illustrative icons and no tick, cross or arrow graphics
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key neutral studio light, front-left softbox key with a fill card, butterfly light on skin crops, skimming sweep across matte mud ridges, soft contact shadows only and never a wet specular on a velvet finish; the one outdoor crop keeps a hard afternoon sun from the upper right
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent airy pastel editorial lip colour visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless porcelain white #FFFFFF, periwinkle #D9E5F1, lotus-lilac #C6B9CB and one coral-rose hairline accent #D65D68, with every lip and swatch hue carried by one accent placeholder; bright even high-key neutral studio lighting with a front-left softbox key and fill card, butterfly light on skin crops, skimming sweep across matte mud ridges, soft contact shadows and no wet speculars; modern geometric sans-serif typography only; thin single-weight hairline window outlines, hairline star rules and blank rounded label pills; stable open-tube-with-flocked-applicator anchor angle and scale with powdery feathered swipe edges; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no fixed lip shade hue across the set
no glossy finish on a matte product
style.presentationRules: one open-tube-with-flocked-applicator anchor reused at stable scale, formula always rendered as powdery velvet with feathered swipe edges, every person cropped inside a window mask or turned away so no identity is held, and every lip or swatch hue carried by the accent placeholder instead of a fixed shade
style.surfaceSystem: seamless white sweep plus lotus-lilac and periwinkle matte boards laid flat for overhead charts, and raw travertine blocks #E9DED0 stacked at differing heights under the still-life stage, no horizon and no table edge visible
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif only: one oversized headline band, one blank label column and small ruled parameter lines, all in-image copy supplied at generation time as placeholders
